a named person or organizational role that accepts accountability and stop authority
a named and funded day-to-day operating role
venue, participants, resources, lawful access, and partners

pilot_gates.public_label: what is allowed and what stops the pilot
pilot_gates.requirement: permitted actions, prohibited consequences, and an explicit stop condition

invariants: Evidence and preparation do not grant access, spend, work, publication, representation, or release authority.
Assistance and place evidence may not become risk, eligibility, enforcement, resident, property, or other adverse standing.
Sources, decisions, holds, receipts, and handoffs must remain legible after the original person leaves.

programs.label: Essential Tools
programs.own: Program purpose, member relationship, local policy, canonical tool references, accepted custody receipts.
programs.commodity: MyTurn or another inventory system performs reservations, checkout, return, and fees.
programs.next: Define the exact export and reconciliation contract.

programs.label: Essential Time
programs.own: Credit policy, eligible performance, acceptance authority, named participant accounts, portable receipts.
programs.commodity: Time-bank workflow donors may inform interface and operations.
programs.next: Operate one real low-consequence contribution chain.

programs.label: Essential Pilotage
programs.own: Scope, referral boundary, accepted service, contribution recognition, next accountable provider.
programs.commodity: Scheduling, messaging, forms, maps, and directories remain replaceable.
programs.next: Define recipient acknowledgement and steward acceptance.

programs.label: Mobility / E-bike
programs.own: Project purpose, participants, eligibility, safety, local authority, condition and custody semantics.
programs.commodity: Tool custody now; hardware and mesh adapters later.
programs.next: Map repair, access, custody, and instruction events.

programs.label: Prevention & Support
programs.own: Purpose limitation, privacy, safety, service authority, acceptance, referral and evidence boundary.
programs.commodity: Forms, scheduling, messaging, donor tooling, and specialist systems remain replaceable.
programs.next: Admit only bounded capacity needs into the commons.

programs.label: Stewardship / Place
programs.own: Place interpretation, evidence class, purpose firewall, safe-action logic, local authority and handoff.
programs.commodity: External data and provider services remain bounded inputs.
programs.next: Carry qualified needs into Attention or the commons.

programs.label: Money / Fundraising
programs.own: Constituent continuity, purpose, project allocation, restrictions, commitments, receipts, durable transaction references.
programs.commodity: Givebutter, Network for Good, Stripe, Square, and later rails move money or render views.
programs.next: Build the dashboard as a projection over canonical identity, purpose, project, restriction, processor, and receipt.

rules.label: Identity
rules.note: Manzanita owns the relationships and record.
rules.detail: A vendor account may reference a person or organization, but it does not become the canonical relationship.

rules.label: Authority
rules.note: A dashboard does not create standing.
rules.detail: No interface, model, or processor may manufacture acceptance, obligation, credit, representation, or external effect.

rules.label: Evidence
rules.detail: Intent, commitment, performed event, acknowledgement, acceptance, credit, settlement, and custody close remain distinct.

rules.label: Handoff
rules.note: Pilotage prepares the next safe action.
rules.detail: The next accountable provider receives only the bounded context, evidence, purpose, and authority required.

rules.label: Commodity perimeter
rules.note: MyTurn, processors, fundraising platforms, OSS, and hardware are replaceable machinery.
rules.detail: The organization must be able to reconstruct its own operating record after supplier loss.

scope: Read-only projection from existing public owners. Source owners remain separate; no municipal adoption or new institutional authority.
